The '''''Valor Prevails''''' was a [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnought]] used by the resurgent [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. It was under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Eisek]] and patrolled the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]].
